posts.title: Stop Building Every kustomization.yaml in CI
posts.description: You have a GitOps repo. It has 35 kustomization.yaml files across clusters, components, demos, and tests. You want CI to validate that your manifests actually build. posts.title: AI Didn't Design This BNG. Experience Did.
posts.description: When I open-sourced the eBPF BNG last month, someone on Hacker News called it “vibe coded.” I understand why. The project moved fast — a working distributed BNG with eBPF/XDP packet processing, DHCP, RADIUS, NAT, PPPoE, BGP, and a coordination service, all open-sourced within weeks. That’s suspicious.
